plugins.description: Real mountains, glass and paintings made with code and real elevation data, no image model. Six print styles for any peak on Earth, photographic terrain with lakes and city lights, a path tracer for still lifes, an oil and watercolour simulator for original paintings of any subject, and whole landscapes as one self-drawing HTML file.
